Guides for the equipment in our room. Most of them are about the **Behringer X32** digital mixer.

## X32

- [Drums on one fader: DCA groups and mute groups](x32-drums-dca.qmd): put every drum mic on one fader,
  and mute the whole kit with one button.
- The Live Sound lessons teach the X32 channel strip itself:
  [gain](../lessons/live-gain.qmd), [EQ](../lessons/live-eq.qmd), [gates](../lessons/live-gate.qmd),
  [compression](../lessons/live-comp.qmd), [feedback](../lessons/live-feedback.qmd),
  [sound check](../lessons/live-soundcheck.qmd).

## Yamaha MODX

- [Yamaha MODX](modx.qmd): finding sounds, and using it as an audio interface: one USB cable
  records the keyboard and plays the computer back.
- [Play the band on the MODX](modx-band.qmd): the site's backing band plays its bass, keys, guitar or drums
  on the MODX, steered from the browser. Compare each sound and pick the better one.

## Speaking

- [Using a mic: a guide for speakers](using-a-mic.qmd): slow down, say every consonant, and what the
  engineer can and can't fix.

## Manuals

- Behringer, *X32 Digital Mixer Preliminary User Manual*
  ([PDF](https://media.vsl-uk.com/manuals/sound/Behringer_X32_User_Manual.pdf)).
- Patrick-Gilles Maillot, *Unofficial X32/M32 OSC Remote Protocol*
  ([PDF](https://tostibroeders.nl/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/X32-OSC.pdf)): every setting and its range.
